# HELP mock_server_pending_delayed_tasks All delayed tasks waiting for their delay, bounded or not
# TYPE mock_server_pending_delayed_tasks gauge
mock_server_pending_delayed_tasks 0.0
# HELP mock_server_scheduler_queued_tasks Tasks queued on the shared action scheduler pool (response delays, forward continuations, drift analysis)
# TYPE mock_server_scheduler_queued_tasks gauge
mock_server_scheduler_queued_tasks 0.0

results.note: its semantic analysis holds the only action thread (actionHandlerThreadCount 1) for 20 s (longer here so all 30 forwards arrive while it holds the thread, even on a loaded machine). The backend answers after 30 s, but the client's read timeout, maxSocketTimeout (20 s by default), ends the call first (and before llmRequestTimeoutMillis does), so it fails, nothing is cached, and each later analysis waits 20 s for the backend again (a 20 s backend raced the read timeout, and won in the 9.1.0 recording)

30 forwards at once: each one's continuation waits for the thread, first come first served; once it is free, each continuation submits its analysis behind the remaining continuations, so the first 16 fill the backlog (max(16, 4 x 1 thread)) and the other 14 are shed
